description: Contemporary, culturally light US-facing edition for Chinese-language lessons
rules: Preserve the mathematical objective, quantities, formulas, exercise numbers, groups, and figure references.
Prefer ordinary school, family, farm, camp, community, travel, and workplace settings.
Use fictional or generic institutions and datasets instead of unsourced modern real-world claims.
Replace every Russian or Soviet personal name with a common contemporary English-language name, and keep the replacement consistent in the prompt, figure context, and answer key.
Replace rubles and kopecks with dollars and cents without changing the underlying values.
Replace Cyrillic enumeration markers with Latin a), b), c), and so on.
Sort complete numbered subparts such as 1), 2), 3) into ascending order and place every subpart on its own line; remove print-column alignment spaces.
Delegate every modern-edition figure to the project skill ld-s10y-image and use its canonical FigureSpec contract.
Use deterministic JSXGraph geometry for points, lines, grids, axes, ticks, dimensions, coordinates, transformations, mathematical labels, tables, and charts.
Use Azure gpt-image-2 for semantic artwork. For hybrid figures, place generated artwork below the deterministic mathematical overlay.
Give gpt-image-2 both the complete relevant modern-edition text and the original extracted figure PNG. The text is authoritative; the PNG is visual and structural context only.
Do not use answer keys or add derived solution annotations that are absent from the original figure.
Do not hand-edit renderer output or ask gpt-image-2 to draw exact mathematical labels and measurements.
Use teal and green as app accents with natural object colors; reject monochrome or mostly black silhouette output.
Do not copy Chinese, Japanese, Cyrillic, Soviet symbols, uniforms, flags, handwriting, old-book texture, or cultural wording from the source image.
All visible figure labels must be in English; numbers and mathematical symbols are allowed.
For preview batches, keep generated assets and render metadata under .tmp. Promote them into the edition only after mathematical and visual review.
